## Safety checklist

- [ ] No token, credential, real hostname, customer data, or production topology is included.
- [ ] Collection remains separate from conclusions.
- [ ] New rules include a compensating-control challenge and clean lookalike test.
- [ ] No provider mutation, implicit SSH, or live probing was added.
- [ ] Tests, lint, types, schemas, build, demo, and secret scan pass.
- [ ] Adapted code/data and licenses are documented.
